row:
Hey-Josh here! I'm a rehabilitation counselor; my job is to help people explore and select new careers that fit within their own unique set of skills and interests. Thats a fancy way a saying, I'm gonna help you find out about careers that you can succeed in and that pay well. As the founder of Kustom Careers, I will be presenting you with brief and informative videos on many of todays best careers. In addition, I focus on careers that only require a year or two of training and then you'll be on your way working in your new career. It might come as a surprise to some of you but the training for many of these great careers can be found at your local community college at a fraction of the cost of a college or university. Anyway, I'm really glad you found my channel, thanks so much for checking it out. Don't forget to hit that like and subscribe button and let me know in the comments section below the videos you'd like to see in the future.

Thanks,

Josh
